_comment: realtime_threshold_s es un parametro de DISENO (no medico): a partir de que demora de comunicacion (segundos, solo ida) la app prioriza actuar a bordo antes de esperar a tierra. No proviene de ninguna fuente medica.
tagline: Health guidance for when help is light-minutes away.
disclaimer: Earth Is Far is a decision-support tool. It does not replace a flight surgeon or a physician. If in doubt, contact medical professionals.
